title: feat(gen): SEP-2127 MCP Server Cards and AI Catalog discovery
author: SvirepyiBambr

gist.summary: Added SEP-2127 discovery for hosted MCP servers: GET /.well-known/ai-catalog.json lists each server and links to its GET /mcp/:serverId/server-card. Cards are derived from the existing MCP_SERVERS registry and describe each server, its streamable-HTTP endpoint, and the required Bearer API key. The catalog and cards are public metadata routes, separate from the authenticated MCP connection; they include CORS headers, one-hour public caching, ETags, and 304 responses for matching If-None-Match requests. Added a catalog link to llms.txt and moved shared server-JSON generation into shared/registry/mcp-server-json.ts.
